profile.headline: Innovative Semantic Search & NLP Expert
profile.summary: Relentless in the pursuit of solving meaningful customer problems, with a strong focus on delivering practical and elegant solutions that create lasting value. Places a high priority on deeply understanding user needs and business objectives before selecting tools or technologies. Believes that technology must serve the problem, not dictate the solution. Champions a product vision that balances innovation with usability, ensuring that new ideas are grounded in real-world impact. Brings a leadership approach that fosters clarity, collaboration, and accountability, guiding teams to align around shared goals and to execute with purpose. Approaches emerging technologies with disciplined curiosity, evaluating their potential to drive outcomes rather than following trends.

positions.title: Solutions Architect
positions.description: Spearheaded the design and development of Ai Translate Analytics, a cross-lingual semantic analysis platform enabling early document assessment before translation. Sole engineer for all C# development, system architecture, and deployment across internal and client environments. Integrated third-party APIs (e.g., Omniscien) and built a custom ASP.NET Core REST API to extend platform capabilities. Played a key role in ideation, implementation, and executive demos. Mentored interns and supported leadership with strategic initiatives.

positions.title: Federal Solutions Engineer
positions.description: Led NLP innovation for the Rosette platform across the Intelligence Community. Sole developer of Semantic Studio, a Windows-based prototype tool showcasing Rosette and Identity Resolver capabilities—widely used in demos, customer engagements, and e-Discovery partnerships (e.g., with Linguistic Systems, Inc.). Collaborated on RESTful API development for entity disambiguation and integrated external data sources like Wikidata and HERE. Self-taught Python to build a full-featured training course for Rosette’s APIs, enabling data scientists to unlock the platform’s full potential.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Led R&D on award-winning C# solutions for rapid data triage and big data analysis, integrating Rosette Text Analytics, MongoDB, Microsoft Translator, and advanced visualization tools (FoamTree, Carrot2). Developed a semantic analysis platform that cut triage times by 90%, uncovering high-value documents and themes in hours instead of weeks. Researched and implemented distributed OCR using Tesseract, script detection, and translation for scanned/image-based content. Explored multimedia info extraction with Nexidia (audio) and PittPatt (facial recognition). Managed all lab infrastructure, including Windows servers (physical & AWS), Active Directory, and prototype iOS apps. Regularly briefed and trained users and leadership on advanced tech integrations.
